title: Markdown
description: Writes and previews .md — the store's ordinary document.

title: Code
description: Opens any source or data file as text with syntax colouring. The fallback when nothing more specific claims a file.

title: Plain text
description: Opens .txt and the store's own markers as plain text.

title: Images
description: Shows PNG, JPEG, GIF and the rest, stepping through a folder's pictures and deleting one.

title: SVG images
description: Draws .svg on a canvas — moving, resizing and styling its shapes — and edits its source.

title: PDF
description: Reads a PDF page by page.

title: ePub
description: Reads an ePub book.

title: Architecture diagrams
description: Draws .arch.md as an interactive canvas, and the fenced archdia blocks inside a markdown file.

title: Graphs
description: Edits .graph.json — nodes and edges.

title: Mindmaps
description: Edits .mmap.json, and offers one beside a markdown document.

title: Feature matrices
description: Scores options against MoSCoW-weighted features (.fmat.json).

title: Templates
description: Edits .temp.md and instantiates one into the store.

title: Activity log
description: Records time against projects in .actlog.jsonl.

title: Hybridflow boards
description: A board as cards on a canvas, chained to what comes after them, and a panel listing the chains being played. Plays them where the assembly holds a chat.

title: Tags
description: The words a store files its work under, and the colour each is worn in.

title: Bookmarks
description: The documents kept at hand, as a panel over one JSON file.

title: Conversations
description: The chat with the agents — Claude, Codex, Muse — and what plays a board's flow nodes.

title: TTS scripts
description: Edits a .ttst.md — the monolingual text read aloud to synthesize audio.

title: Video
description: Plays videos and recordings, steps a video image by image or key image by key image, and marks named segments of either in a sidecar beside it.

title: 3D models
description: Turns a .glb on a stage.
